steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: You...
Your consciousness returns, and you realize you're in an entirely white space. Time and space are distorted here, and only a translucent figure in the distance comes into focus.
You open your eyes wide, but still can't see the almost shattered figure clearly, nor can you hear her voice clear.
She approaches you, seemingly smiling. Her familiar smile makes your heart race.

steps.speaker: Girl in the Dream
steps.content: ...Come here... my...
She responds to your question, her lips moving as if saying something. But no matter how hard you try, you can't hear her.
Sensing something, the white shadow also reaches out to you. Just before your fingertips touch...
[Scene Transition: Chief's Office. Transition, screen shakes, alarm sound]
Opening your eyes again, all you can see in your blurry line of vision is a glowing object. Your comms is ringing sharply, giving you a headache.
You lay your head back on the desk, but the familiar figure from your dream appears before your eyes again. This is not the first time she has appeared.
For some reason, you've been plagued by the same dream recently. The white shadow repeatedly appears in your dreams, approaches, then dissipates as you awaken.
Why? Is it Mania? Aftereffects from a mission? Or...
You've forgotten a lot of things; thinking it over is no need. It's better to pull yourself together and face the upcoming work.
[Transition, ringing again]
You hear a noise again—someone's ringing the doorbell.

options: Get up and open the door

choices.text: Get up and open the door

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it's Nightingale. Regarding the dark web operation, we have made some new progress.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: In recent days, a hacker named <000> has been extremely active on the internet. The virus she created is able to force its way into operation systems and take over control. It's extremely dangerous.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: More importantly... we have detected Mania on the virus. Chief, we've discovered that this hacker is a Sinner and is likely connected to the dark web.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. That's why we need you to interrogate her personally this time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This Sinner has been captured and delivered to the Bureau at the moment. Chief, please be careful during the interrogation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, you sound very tired. Please don't overexert yourself and get some rest after work.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Now... let's go meet this troublesome guest.
You feel stilled upon seeing the girl.
It's not that she looks any special. In fact, she doesn't stand out that much; she seems just a typical Eastside fashion girl.
You feel nothing weird, but more a strong sense of déjà vu... you feel like having seen her somewhere before.
Hi... What a slowpoke. I've been waiting for you for a long time.
Of course! I've been snooping on you through the web for months, but this is our first time face-to-face.
Remember? I've saved you several times.
The girl with cat ears winks at you, hinting at something.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You are...
Bingo!
Nice to meet you. You can call me 000. From now on, I'm a Sinner under the MBCC's care.
Your Intelligence Department is really impressive. They immediately found my hiding spot from just a small bug I left behind.
So, you've cracked quite a few of the Easter Eggs I hid online. Impressive! Too bad I don't have any prizes on hand, so consider this a verbal high-five.
You stare at the girl in front of you—since you've entered, her gaze lingered on you only for a few seconds before turning away to observe the room.
The sense of déjà vu grows stronger. This conversation seems to have happened once before, but you have no memory of it, and your mind is spinning.
You hear a crisp, sudden sound... 000 snaps her fingers in front of you.
Hey, focus please? Get on with your questions. I am about to go pick out my bed soon.
You realize you've been staring at her for too long... long enough for her to notice and look back at you.
Her reminder makes your mind a bit clearer. Putting aside the sense of déjà vu, you get down to business.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Nice to meet you, Sinner 000.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I hope you will cooperate with this interrogation. I do have quite a few questions for you.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Since July N.F. 114, a series of destructive acts have occurred on the DisCity web. According to the Cybersecurity Center's investigations, these were caused by hidden virus data.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: On July 4, Councilor Craig Rouen was the first to make a report. He claimed that his comms device was hacked, his information leaked, and that he was blackmailed. Did you do this?
Yeah.
Speaking of which... After sealing the deal, I didn't even have time to log out before he snitched... What a shameless councilor, eh?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...So you broadcasted a video of him cheating with his assistant on a billboard screen on the Fifth Avenue?
That's right! Too bad the admin pulled the plug just as the video was getting spicy. What a buzzkill.
The girl's face and tone show no hint of guilt; she seems purely disappointed that the video wasn't fully shown.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Also, half a month ago, Phantom Entertainment's website was hacked—the homepage was replaced with a simple sketch created using the system's default drawing software.
Actually, it might be a stretch to even call it a "sketch." It looked like it was produced by a toddler who had never held a brush...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The drawing depicted two yellow ducks... frolicking each other. It hogged Phantom's homepage for nearly three hours, during which its subscribers were unable to access any other content.
That's right! That's also my doing!
Their soap operas are all just two people in ridiculous melodrama with a dull happy ending. How can that compete with the artistry of my drawings?
You should thank me for saving Eastsiders three precious hours of their lives.
The girl's indignant jabber almost makes you laugh.
The documented crimes are all quite absurd: Hijacking DisCity's radio signals and blasting "Elysium Island" for seven hours straight... The incidents are all pranks with no clear motives.
Hmm... Truth, justice, and fairness in the world?
The girl blinks dramatically, looking mischievous.
Alright, while I'm just an ordinary girl during the day, at night I transform into Eastside's cyber vigilante: Oracle!
Now you know my true identity. I've been secretly helping the Public Security Bureau in Eastside, so I'm practically one of your pals. Time to let me go, eh?
You've heard of the name "Oracle" from a bestselling superhero comic series in DisCity. 000 is just mimicing the signature pose of this character.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: At most, it can only confine some strays sneaking out at night to cause trouble. Besides...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Oracle wouldn't sneak onto someone's rooftop to broadcast R-rated videos.
Heh, isn't it funny?
Come on, gimme a smile. Why so serious?
Oh, I get it... are you planning to keep me here by force and then... No way.
The girl in front of you pretends to be shocked and genuinely worried.

options: Yeah, now you know the MBCC.

choices.text: Yeah, now you know the MBCC.

steps.content: You clear your throat and knock on the table, steering the conversation back on track.
000 didn't expect you to admit it so calmly. As she's frozen in surprise, you knock on the table, steering the conversation back on track.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let's continue. Anything else you want to say?
I've already told you everything. The little pranks I did have already been thoroughly investigated by your colleagues. They're all in the papers in front of you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Then let's talk about something else. Think of it as me wanting to get to know you.
Get to know me?
This time, she is genuinely surprised. She blinks rapidly and then laughs.
Sure, what do you want to know? My height, weight, measurements? What do I like and dislike? Is there anything you don't already know?
Her information is indeed recorded in the Bureau's archives, but that's not what you're interested in.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The MBCC has extracted your personal file from the database. 000, Dark Web Hacker... those are just your code names and disguises.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You were born in N.F. 96 in Eastside and grew up in the university where your parents worked. As a child, you showed prodigious talent in network technology, earning you early admission into the university...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But in N.F. 108, your parents died in an accident. You were adopted but soon went missing. The records end there, until you reappeared as the hacker 000 this year.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What happened during those missing years?
The room falls silent. The smile on 000's face slowly vanishes.
Wow, the technicians here are really something, doxing me for all this.
Want to take a guess? A young girl who lost her parents, with enviable talent, falling into the chaos of DisCity... Who would target her? What choices would she make to survive?
Her words are heavy, but 000's expression remains playful. She doesn't seem to be recounting her past but rather...
A sense of déjà vu surges up again. A blurry memory flashes in your mind... a broken body, with her silhouette as she leaves you to fight on her own.
Chief? Hello? Are you listening?
A hand waves in front of you, snapping you back to reality.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Sorry, I just spaced out and remembered some other things.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: There was someone like you before... She always lied with a cunning smile, hid the truth, yet ending up alone facing all the problems.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Maybe... if she had been willing to seek help from others, her story might have a different ending.
They're the most basic up and down movements and very poorly attempted, but OwO's eyes can't help chasing the lion head up and down.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Nothing. Just an old story.
After all, the person might just be a figment of your imagination.
...That's indeed a sad story. You're going to make me cry.
In return, let me share a story with you.
Hmm... A long, long time ago, there was a poor girl born into tragedy. She went through countless hardships, which made her paranoid and cynical, leading her astray.
But deep down, she still holds a bit of her innocence, a kind heart, and a soul of gold. She just never met the right person, the one who lends a hand.
The air thickens with a strange tension. 000 lowers her eyes, her gaze falling on the file in front of you, as if lost in thought.
Until...
Ta-da! Our brilliant MBCC Chief makes a grand debut!
Under Chief's meticulous care, the poor Sinner feels the warmth of the world again and she lets go of her tragic past. She reforms and embraces tomorrow...
Congrats, congrats!
What's wrong? Isn't this your favorite kind of story?
The girl's lips still grinning though, the smile has vanished from her eyes.
You've asked me so many questions. Now it's my turn.
Chief, is all this selfless kindness and concern... because you see me as someone who needs pity?
Or are you using those eyes...
...to see someone else's shadow in me?
[Transition, screen shakes, alarm sounds]
Before the girl finishes speaking, a piercing alarm rings out from outside the interrogation room. Alarmed, you drop the files onto the floor.
A call from Nightingale comes through the comms. With no time to grab the files, you pick up her call.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Bureau's server has been attacked by an unknown data stream, and some functions are disabled...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It will take the technical department 15 minutes to reboot the system. Please stay put before then. I have sent staff to your office, they'll arrive soon.
You hang up on Nightingale and turn around, only to see the girl jump off the chair and head for the door.
The previously closed door of the interrogation room is now wide open. The girl moves so naturally that she even picks up the fallen files along the way, leaving you stunned.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Where are you going?
Hmm... I'll just look around and pick out a room I like. Oh, and also...
The girl turns and flashes that familiar wild smile.
Sinner? Dark Web Hacker? Poor child? Hmph, don't look at me with those eyes. These words can't define me, and this place can't confine me.
Who I am has nothing to do with any of you... only I can decide!
At the end of the conversation, the girl makes a face then steps away amid the chaos, leaving you alone in the interrogation room, dumbfounded.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, is everything alright?

options: I'm fine. Just handle the alarm.

choices.text: I'm fine. Just handle the alarm.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Glad you're alright! We've conducted a thorough check, and the incident isn't serious. The Bureau's system will be repaired soon...
The emergency protocol initiates, and the disturbance is quickly resolved under your command. Wynn breathes a sigh of relief but then realizes something's amiss.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Huh, where's the Sinner you were interrogating just now?
Who I am has nothing to do with any of you... only I can decide!
You haven't encountered someone so unruly and reckless in quite a long time.
Yet, inexplicably, you find it somewhat amusing and nostalgic.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: She shouldn't have gone far... I think.
[Black screen transition]
[Scene transition, back to the white space]
In your dream, you once again meet the figure you miss so dearly.
Unlike her stubborn, standoffish attitude during the day, you feel her leaning on your shoulder from behind you. You can even feel her warmth.
But when you try to grab her, she quickly leaps back, leaving you grasping the air.

steps.speaker: Girl in the Dream
steps.content: ...Hehe...
As if teasing you, the girl lets out a warm and mischievous giggle.
You turn your head, but her face remains indistinct. The untouchable string of gigles makes you feel frustrated but somehow comforted.
But soon, the laughter turns into something else... a jarring, mechanical noise... an alarm?

steps.speaker: Mechanical Sound
steps.content: Warning... System error... System error...
You open your eyes to the deafening sound of an alarm. Glancing at the clock on the wall, you see that only an hour and a half has passed since you fell sleep.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Bureau's server is under attack again and some functions in the living area are paralyzed...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Understood. I'm heading to the office now.
You struggle out of bed. Sighing deeply, you put on your coat and quickly leave the room.
